card.name: Last digit of Psalm or Job chapter
card.fires_on: The final digit of a chapter number in a Bible reference, mostly after Psalm or Job (e.g. Psa. 116, Job 38). It also fires in a few other books such as Proverbs or Timothy.

modes.label: Psalm chapter digit
modes.description: The last digit of a Psalms chapter number in a citation or discussion.

modes.label: Job chapter digit
modes.description: The last digit of a chapter number in Job, before the colon and verse.

card.plain: It marks the end of a chapter number in a Bible citation, mainly Psalms and Job.
